newsitem.title: SOUTH AFRICA: HOECHST LEAPS HIGHER ON GOOD H1 RESULTS.
newsitem.headline: HOECHST LEAPS HIGHER ON GOOD H1 RESULTS.

text.p: Shares in South African chemicals, oils and plastics firm Hoechst SA Ltd roared higher on Tuesday after the company reported good interim earnings, dealers said.
At 0835 GMT Hoechst's stock was up 10 cents at 390 cents, having earlier climbed to 395 cents.
"I think they are up on the results. It's a very good set of results," one dealer at the Johannesburg Stock Exchange said.
Hoechst on Monday reported headline earnings for the six months-ended June 30, up to 16.0 cents from 11.5 cents in the comparable period a year ago.
Attributable earnings were up at 19.3 cents versus 10.2 cents, with the dividend at 5.0 cents from 3.0 cents in the previous period.
